variants.name: MMS-TTS Telugu (ONNX)
variants.notes: No official Meta or sherpa-onnx-team ONNX export of mms-tts-tel exists. This is a community conversion (willwade/mms-tts-multilingual-models-onnx), confirmed present on Hugging Face 2026-09-12 (model.onnx, tokens.txt, sample.wav in the tel/ folder). Documented here per the plan's instruction to use the correct current source rather than an outdated/nonexistent identifier.

variants.name: MMS-TTS Telugu (sherpa-onnx)
variants.architecture: VITS (sherpa-onnx compatible ONNX export of facebook/mms-tts-tel)
variants.notes: k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx's official tts-models release has no Telugu asset (checked GitHub release 2026-09-12). Using sriram09764/itantra-tts-onnx instead, a community conversion in the standard sherpa-onnx VITS layout (model.onnx + tokens.txt + config.json), confirmed present on Hugging Face. Not an officially maintained k2-fsa asset; documenting the substitution rather than silently treating it as official.
variants.failureReason: sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 OfflineTts.generate() segfaults (native crash) on this community ONNX conversion (sriram09764/itantra-tts-onnx), reproduced even with a single trivial Telugu word. Model loads fine; crash is inside synthesis. Likely an incomplete/incorrect ONNX export (missing embedded metadata sherpa-onnx's VITS runner expects) rather than an environment issue, since loading and the separate willwade ONNX export both work. Not pursued further; recorded as a genuine failure rather than retried indefinitely.

variants.name: Vakyansh Telugu Glow-TTS (female)
variants.notes: Checkpoint URL confirmed reachable (HTTP 200) and sized 2026-09-13. Vocoder is shared between both Telugu voices. Required a C compiler (Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools, already installed on this host) to build the repos own monotonic_align Cython extension; also needed several small compatibility patches for modern torch/numpy: torch.qr -> torch.linalg.qr, torch.load(..., weights_only=False) for the trusted checkpoint, and reading config.json as UTF-8 (PYTHONUTF8=1) instead of the Windows-default cp1252.

variants.name: Vakyansh Telugu Glow-TTS (male)
variants.notes: Checkpoint URL confirmed reachable (HTTP 200) and sized 2026-09-13. Shares the same vocoder checkpoint as the female voice. Same compiler/compatibility fixes as the female voice (see its notes). This specific voice segfaults intermittently during synthesis on this hardware (observed ~1 in 3 runs); the published sample is from a successful run. Not yet root-caused; flagged here as a real stability finding rather than hidden.

variants.name: IndicF5
variants.notes: Architecture, license and inference API confirmed from the model card 2026-09-13. Outputs 24000Hz. Requires a reference prompt audio + its transcript at inference time (voice cloning conditioned), which the model card's own repo ships in a prompts/ folder (no Telugu one included there, only Marathi and Punjabi).
variants.failureReason: ai4bharat/IndicF5 is a gated Hugging Face model: downloading requires a Hugging Face account to request and be granted access, then an API token to authenticate the download. No such account/token exists in this environment, and creating one or entering credentials is outside what an automated session should do. Needs the project owner to request access on huggingface.co/ai4bharat/IndicF5 with their own account and provide an HF_TOKEN before this can be installed.

variants.name: Chiluka TTS Telugu
variants.notes: Investigated 2026-09-13: huggingface.co/Seemanth/chiluka-tts returns HTTP 401 ("Invalid username or password") for anonymous access, and no corroborating reference to a Telugu "Chiluka" TTS model was found via web search. This is Hugging Face's generic response for both nonexistent and private/inaccessible repos, so it is not possible to tell which from outside. Not substituting a different model under this name; recording it as unverifiable rather than fabricating details.

variants.name: Chatterbox Indic LoRA (Telugu)
variants.framework: pytorch (chatterbox-tts package + repo's own indic-lora loader)
variants.notes: Confirmed via Hugging Face API 2026-09-13: public, not gated, ships te_female.pt/te_male.pt conditioning plus a checkpoints/best.pt LoRA adapter (~165MB total). Loads on top of the base ResembleAI/chatterbox model (not bundled here, downloaded separately by the chatterbox-tts package), so total footprint is larger than this repo alone.
variants.failureReason: Out of scope for this project, same reasoning as the sibling shankarpandala/chatterbox-telugu variant: this is a LoRA adapter over the same GPU-oriented ResembleAI/chatterbox base model, which was confirmed impractical on CPU on this hardware. Not attempted for that reason rather than a separate failure.

variants.name: Chatterbox Telugu (shankarpandala)
variants.notes: Confirmed via Hugging Face API 2026-09-13: public, not gated, self-contained checkpoint (t3_mtl_te.safetensors + s3gen.pt + ve.pt + conds.pt, ~3.06GB). chatterbox-tts 0.1.7 installed cleanly in an isolated venv.
variants.failureReason: Out of scope for this project: ResembleAI Chatterbox (and its Telugu fine-tune) is designed and tuned for GPU inference. Two CPU attempts confirmed this is impractical, not just slow: one pushed the host system drive to near-zero free space via pagefile growth, and a retry with headroom restored stalled for 10+ minutes with almost no CPU progress. Since this project exists to find models that work on ordinary CPUs (for future JARVIS use on laptops/phones), a GPU-oriented model does not fit the goal regardless of whether it could eventually be made to run.

variants.name: MahaTTS v2 Telugu
variants.architecture: Text-to-Semantic (Gemma-backbone causal LM) -> Semantic-to-Mel (flow) -> BigVGAN vocoder
variants.notes: Confirmed via Hugging Face API and README 2026-09-13: Telugu is explicitly listed as supported (multilingual/cross-lingual voice cloning via wav2vec2/M4T semantic tokens, not a Telugu-specific finetune). Not gated. Requires 3 reference audio clips at inference; the repo only ships Hindi reference speakers, no Telugu ones, so this project's own consistent reference-audio choice will be used instead. Total checkpoint size across 3 files (BigVGAN 450MB + T2S 3.3GB + S2A flow 863MB) = 4.6GB. Deliberately not attempted yet: at 4.6GB this is the largest checkpoint in the whole catalog, and loading the shankarpandala/chatterbox-telugu model (a much smaller ~3GB checkpoint) already pushed this host's nearly-full system drive (C:) to a dangerously low ~250MB free via pagefile growth. Deferred until more disk headroom exists on the host. Update 2026-09-13: deferred this session after the smaller (~3GB) shankarpandala/chatterbox-telugu model stalled on CPU twice (once a disk-safety kill, once an apparent 10+ minute hang); this 4.6GB checkpoint carries the same or greater risk on this hardware.
